name: hk_x_conservation_pop
requirements: Total grid population whose cell point lies inside any Conservation land_use_zone polygon. Store conservation_pop (int).

turns.query: Using the HK_population_1km grid (datasets/HK_population_1km.csv; each row is a grid cell with a longitude/latitude point and a population count), compute the total population of all grid cells whose point (its longitude/latitude, SRID 4326) falls INSIDE any land_use_zone polygon of land_category 'Conservation'. Return the total population, rounded to the nearest integer.
